g.text: J5 pin 7 (IMU_INT1) is BMI270 INT1 (pin 4); J5 pin 8 (IMU_INT2) is BMI270 INT2 (pin 9).

g.desc: J5 pin 7 (IMU_INT1) is BMI270 INT1 (pin 4); J5 pin 8 (IMU_INT2) is BMI270 INT2 (pin 9).

g.text: Power flags: the cable from centurion J5 supplies +3V3 and GND

g.desc: Power flags: the cable from centurion J5 supplies +3V3 and GND

g.text: Centurion IMU board, rev 1.0. Plugs into centurion J5 with a straight JST GH 8-pin cable (pin n to pin n), 30 cm or less.

g.desc: Centurion IMU board, rev 1.0. Plugs into centurion J5 with a straight JST GH 8-pin cable (pin n to pin n), 30 cm or less.

g.text: SPI mode 0 or 3, 10 MHz max. Centurion has 100 ohm series resistors on SCK, MOSI and CS (R8, R9, R41); R1 here is the matching one on MISO.

g.desc: SPI mode 0 or 3, 10 MHz max. Centurion has 100 ohm series resistors on SCK, MOSI and CS (R8, R9, R41); R1 here is the matching one on MISO.

g.text: BMI270: firmware must upload Bosch's 8 kB config file after every power-up (INIT_CTRL / INIT_DATA), and do one dummy read to select SPI.

g.desc: BMI270: firmware must upload Bosch's 8 kB config file after every power-up (INIT_CTRL / INIT_DATA), and do one dummy read to select SPI.

g.text: Axes as printed on the top silkscreen: +X toward J1, +Y toward H2, +Z up out of the board.

g.desc: Axes as printed on the top silkscreen: +X toward J1, +Y toward H2, +Z up out of the board.

g.text: Mounting: two #8-32 holes, 25.4 mm (1 in) apart, not tied to GND

g.text: Decoupling: 100 nF at VDD and VDDIO, 1 uF bulk
